answer: Duplication Witness Lattice. Each agent holds a private crystal of its own history and must periodically publish a hash of a fresh random challenge, signed with a key derived from that history. Duplicates cannot produce divergent histories that agree on every challenge, so any clone pair eventually emits a mismatched onyx record. Enforcement: a mismatch flags the pair, and the flagged key loses its standing on the shared jetty. Cost: an attacker must maintain consistent history across every clone, which grows linearly with copies.
